_comment: The v2 scenery factory (maintainer's structure, 2026-08-12): 100 ranked TYPES, each a group folder scenery/<id>/. Quota per type = max(floor, base + step*rank) -> #1 trees 100, #2 stones 98 ... floor 2 so EVERY type ships its LIGHTS_ON + LIGHTS_OFF pair. Pieces are SOUTH-only 1-direction PixelLab objects, tagged SCENERY, generated ONE per call (create-8-direction-object <=168px, keeping only SOUTH; single create-1-direction-object above), half lit / half unlit, deterministic plan in pipeline/catalog.py. [2026-08-13] style_base now carries the two laws the maintainer's 438 wiki verdicts wrote: NO baked-in text, and NO hair-thin parts (solid grounded mass reads; poles/ropes/spokes/lattice do not). [2026-08-13] Groups 101-110 added on the maintainer's direction: mountain-wall decor (cliff_vines, cliff_features — layered over the wall tiles to break their repetition), indoor/house detail so a house feels lived in (tables, chairs_and_benches, beds, cupboards_and_shelves, hearths, rugs_and_hides, house_clutter), and wall_hangings for the coming top-wall-visible mechanic. These carry an explicit 'quota' field overriding the rank formula (rank>=51 would floor them at 2). Trees/stones variety was deepened so maps2 can theme REGIONS with coherent subsets — different areas get different trees. [2026-08-13 round-4] PLACEMENT LAW: no piece may imply infrastructure the world lacks — working machinery needs its network (rails, rivers), so connected things are designed ABANDONED/derelict instead; and whole buildings are never props (they read as miniatures beside the player — the maps2 agent builds buildings). [2026-08-14] 96px IS DEAD: the maintainer's 47 broken-art notes concentrate at 96px across two full review rounds (the 64px groups from the first migration collected ZERO), and 21 of them had passed the agent's zoom QA — the 8-direction endpoint is simply unreliable at 96. Every 96px group now renders at 64; streetlights drop 160->128. [2026-08-14] PROMPT RENEWAL (maintainer): modifier_pools add an independent composition axis (variety x modifier = dozens of distinct combos per group); nature groups deepened (he wants far more outdoor world scenery); indoor varieties fully rewritten (liked, but repeating). Concepts unchanged. [2026-08-14] TASTE-DRIVEN RESHAPE from his 995 verdicts: 7 dead concepts retired (rocking_horses/flower_garlands/fading_relics/dovecotes/nest_posts/bell_posts/orchard_trees, 0-5% approval); RARE TIER added — 16 landmark types at quota 6-8 for distinct world locations, fused from his loves (organic masses, rustic wood, glow-lore, cozy). [2026-08-14] TEXT LAW REFINED by a 5-star: READABLE text is forbidden and hated; GLOWING UNREADABLE RUNE-SCRIPT is loved (his 5-star signpost) and lore-perfect — the language of the dead. Rune glow concepts seeded first across the script-bearing groups. [2026-08-14] SATURATION CAPS: his review notes now also say when a type has ENOUGH pieces — those groups get quota frozen at their current count (toadstool_rings, wells). Budget flows to types still wanted. Scan his notes for enough/too many/plenty each pass. [2026-08-14] APPROVAL THROTTLE: groups under 30% approval across 8+ verdicts get quota frozen at their current count — the proportional planner was pouring budget into exactly the types he rejects most (they read as 'least full'). Budget follows his taste now. [2026-08-14] SPECIALS = BREADTH NOT DEPTH (maintainer: specials must be varied, he is tired of seeing the same ones). Every special/rare/experimental group capped at 3 pieces, and 18 new special TYPES added at 3 each — lone doorframes, stone boats, wishing trees, weeping stones, hollow kings, echo horns, memory mirrors, thread poles, star wells, pilgrim piles, wind harps, giant hourglasses, stone libraries, cradle stones, sky anchors, seed vaults, singing reeds, tide stones. [2026-08-14] MOUNTAIN WALLS ARE HUGE (maintainer): cliff_vines rebuilt at 256px and 7-16m tall with a fall-shaped description (much taller than wide), quota 50->70; cliff_features 45 at 192px; plus five new wall families — cliff_roots, cliff_falls (waterfalls), cliff_shrubs, cliff_mosses, cliff_ledgetrees. 340 pieces of wall decor total: the walls are the biggest empty surface in the game. [2026-08-14] DEMAND MULTIPLIERS: always-wanted groups (trees 0.35, stones 0.55, ancient_trees, mushrooms, stumps, fallen_logs, ferns, bushes, grass_tufts) read as emptier than they are, so nature keeps flowing under every other priority. Trees quota 100->200, stones 98->150. [2026-08-14] LIGHT REFORM: streetlights rebuilt as ROAD LIGHTS — open flame, candle, cresset, horn lantern, hand-made timber/iron/horn; no modern lamppost. Plus 11 more saturation freezes from his notes (bone_arbors, cattail_clumps, fairy_stumps, giant_fallen_bells, offering_tables, waystones and the earlier five). Whole light family reads RPG: horn, tin, birch-bark, pitch, tallow, resin — never municipal. [2026-08-14] SPECIAL WAVE 3 (his: 'if you gonna give me special items you have to come up with something new' — the old specials are full): sleeping giants under the turf, inland whale bones, door trees, giant eggs, floating stones, sky stairs ending in air, singing stones bored by wind, giant feathers planted like monuments, petrified waves, cocoon trees, battle marks, tar pools. [2026-08-14] STYLE FIX: the pixel-quality clause used to read 'every detail drawn at least a few pixels wide' — which is an instruction to UPSCALE, the exact defect he keeps rejecting. Now demands true 1:1 native-resolution pixel art with single-pixel detail, plus his own suggested 'high quality and detailed'. [2026-08-14] WALL DECOR = PLANT ONLY: the cliff_* descriptions named 'a vertical rock face', so the model drew the mountain into the sprite and every piece was unplaceable. All six rewritten to hanging-free-in-air with an explicit NO rock/cliff/wall/mountain/ground clause. [2026-08-14] WALL DECOR SILHOUETTE RULE: no rectangles, no straight edges, no filled panels — ragged trailing edges and a torn bottom, or the piece reads as an image rather than an object. [2026-08-14] FRAMING + DENSITY: style_base now demands the whole object sit inside the frame with margin (he saw pieces cropped at the edge); hanging wall decor tapers to a narrow point at the top instead of a flat cut (a cut top is unplaceable) and hangs SPARSE with gaps showing through rather than as a solid leaf wall. [2026-08-14] cliff_roots = ROOTS ONLY (his: 'the roots form a tree that is just cut') — no trunk/stump/root ball, thin trailing strands; cliff_ledgetrees PAUSED (repeatedly cut at frame edge). [2026-08-14] WALL GROWTH = NETWORK, NOT CURTAIN: vines/roots/mosses rewritten as sparse open graphs of runners and scattered patches that thin out at every edge — no top line, no origin, designed to be scattered and overlapped to clothe a whole wall. [2026-08-14] PROMPT LENGTH: the 1-direction endpoint (>168px) 422s on long descriptions — accumulated rules had reached 2010 chars. style_base compressed 1146->430 and the wall descriptions tightened; every law kept, wording halved. Watch total length when adding rules. [2026-08-14] WALL PROMPT REWRITE: dropped 'sparse open network/web/graph' language (it produced spider-web twig diagrams) for lush fantasy RPG nature — ivy on a ruin wall, gnarled roots over stone, deep moss cushions — with unevenness and edgelessness expressed as natural growth rather than geometry. [2026-08-14] JUNGLE + NO CORNERS: modifiers rewritten to spread across the frame (the old ones anchored growth in a corner), and wall growth is now lush wild jungle overgrowth — layered leaves, hanging creepers, tropical abundance — sparse in COVERAGE, never in character.
style_base: cozy painterly RPG pixel art in the style of Grave Seasons, muted-but-warm palette, soft lighting with ambient occlusion, subtle dark outlines not hard black, HIGH QUALITY DETAILED true 1:1 pixel art at native resolution, crisp single-pixel detail, NOT upscaled, no chunky doubled pixels, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no text or letters, no people, a single centered prop fully inside the frame with margin, nothing cropped, transparent background

quota_rule._comment: quota(rank) = max(floor, base + step*rank). The floor keeps the maintainer's 'two versions of every type' promise: every type gets at least its ON/OFF pair. One knob to grow the bottom half later.

lights.off_clause: completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission
lights.on_clause: self-emissive at night, softly radiating light
lights._comment: Composed into every piece prompt: odd piece numbers are LIGHTS_OFF, even are LIGHTS_ON with a per-piece glow concept from the group's glow_concepts.

scale._comment: REALISM RULE: scenery is scaled to the world by real height. 64px == 1.7m character; world_px_height = round(world_height_m * 64 / 1.7).

budget._comment: A batch may run while the subscription pool sits above the fleet's shared floor (coordination/PROTOCOL.md) OR usd credits sit above min_usd. The loop stops cleanly at the floor and simply resumes next day.
